extracted.name: Avocado Feta Salsa
extracted.description: This avocado and feta dip with red onion, tomatoes, and herbs is a chunky, savory summer salsa that tastes great with pita or tortilla chips.
ingredient_lines: 1 ripe avocado - peeled, pitted and chopped
1 tablespoon red or white wine vinegar
instruction_lines: In a bowl, gently stir together tomatoes, avocados, onion, and garlic. Mix in parsley and oregano. Gently stir in olive oil and vinegar, then stir in feta cheese. Cover and chill for 2 to 6 hours.
